title: Version compatibility records (contract 12)
description: The three version records that cross the hub and connector link. 'versions' is what the connector reports about itself inside its hello (contract 05 embeds it by $ref to #/$defs/versions). 'daemon_versions' is what the connector reports about one chat's daemon, at hello and whenever that daemon starts or restarts (contract 05 carries it in its chat.versions frame, C-05.26). 'compat' is the hub's verdict, sent in answer to a hello and again whenever a daemon_versions record changes a chat's verdict. Package versions are compared with web-chat's one comparator, compareVersions in web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/versions.js. The record kind is the discriminator.

kind.description: Which record this is: 'versions' (connector about itself), 'daemon_versions' (connector about one daemon), 'compat' (hub verdict).

package_version.description: A web-chat or ServerWebChat package version as package.json carries it: a release (0.9.0), an alpha (0.9.0-alpha.3) or a dev build (0.9.0-dev.202610280217.a9c22e5, see devVersion in web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/scripts/build-release.js:279; its order says nothing about the age of its code, C-12.11). The pattern is VERSION_RE from web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/mod-protocol.js:158.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its cht_ prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat. Never a path, a port or a registry instanceId.

protocol_range.description: The connector protocol versions (contract 05) a side speaks, inclusive at both ends. An integer counter, independent of the package version.

min.description: Oldest connector protocol version this side still speaks.

max.description: Newest connector protocol version this side speaks.

install.description: How the running tree is installed, as describeInstall in web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/update/install-layout.js:95 classifies it. Decides which remedy the hub's message names.

kind.description: 'managed': unpacked under ~/.web-chat/versions/<v> (claude-web-chat update works). 'dev': a git checkout. 'unmanaged': anything else, including a copy inside another package's node_modules once describeInstall checks node_modules before its git walk (until then such a copy under a git checkout reports 'dev').

link_mismatch.description: describeInstall's linkMismatch: the claude-web-chat on PATH resolves to a different tree than the one running.

session_versions.description: The web-chat builds the Claude Code sessions attached to one daemon run, one row per build, as the registry's package_versions rows carry them (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/portal/picker.js:128 and versionSkew in lib/util/registry.js:932). A session keeps the MCP server build it started with until Claude Code restarts.

version.description: The web-chat build of these sessions' MCP servers.

sessions.description: How many attached sessions run that build.

versions.description: Connector to hub, inside hello: the connector's own versions. Sent once per connection.

package_version.description: packageVersion() of the tree the connector process runs (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/versions.js), read from that tree's package.json.

protocol.description: The connector protocol range (contract 05) the connector speaks.

policy_protocol.description: PORTAL_PROTOCOL_VERSION of the connector's build (12 on the 0.9.0 alphas, web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/versions.js): the generation of the remote-policy route and frame tables the connector enforces (contract 04). Informative for the hub; it never changes the verdict on its own.

schema_version.description: SCHEMA_VERSION of the connector's build (4 on the 0.9.0 alphas): the .web-chat/ state schema its daemons migrate projects to. Informative; contract 05 decides whether the hub uses it.

node.description: process.versions.node of the connector process. The connector refuses to start below NODE_FLOOR (22.12) itself, so the hub only displays this.

platform.description: process.platform of the machine. web-chat supports macOS and Linux (WSL2 counts as Linux).

arch.description: process.arch of the machine, for display.

claude_code_version.description: The Claude Code version the connector found (the dotted version probeMod in lib/setup/registration.js reads out of `claude --version` with /(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/), or null when no claude binary was found. A machine with null can host no agent.

daemons.description: Daemons already running when this hello is sent (a connector restarted while its daemons kept running). Optional; absent means none.

daemon_versions.description: Connector to hub: the versions of one chat's daemon, read from that daemon's GET /api/health (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/health.js:89-148 at aa60492e: package_version, version, boot; catalogue once it lands, C-12.6a). Sent at hello (inside versions.daemons) and on every daemon start or restart in contract 05's chat.versions frame; contract 07's chat.daemon is the hub event recorded from it.

package_version.description: The daemon's /api/health package_version. Differs from the connector's own when the daemon was started by an older build and not yet restarted.

instance_protocol.description: The daemon's /api/health version: PROTOCOL_VERSION, the hub/instance wire counter (3 today). Not the connector protocol.

boot.description: The daemon's /api/health boot (the bus bootId). A new value means the daemon restarted and its sequence space reset (contract 07).

claude_sessions.description: Builds of the Claude Code sessions attached to this daemon. Optional.

catalogue_sha256.description: The sha256 of the daemon's /api/health catalogue report (catalogue.sha256: CATALOGUE_SHA256 in lib/core/versions.js, contract 10 C-10.8), passed on as read. Optional: absent while the daemon's health reports no catalogue (no build at aa60492e does). The hub trusts it only when it equals a known catalogue file's catalogue_sha256; for a daemon on a dev build that decides its catalogue, and no match or no report means pre-catalogue rules (C-12.6a). For any other build the package version decides and this is informative.

observed_at.description: When the connector read the daemon's health, RFC 3339 UTC.

reason.description: One machine-readable reason behind a verdict.

code.description: protocol_unsupported: the protocol ranges do not meet. package_below_min / package_above_max: the connector's package_version is outside the window. daemon_below_min / daemon_above_max: one daemon's is. claude_code_missing / claude_code_below_min: no usable Claude Code. install_dev: the connector runs a dev build (isDevVersion), which the hub judges by its protocol range and the Claude Code rows and never by the package window, so package_below_min and package_above_max never accompany it for that reason (C-12.11); or it runs from a git checkout (install.kind dev), which is not a dev build: it reports its committed version, the package window applies, and the reason names only the remedy, a git pull. The hub tells the two apart by isDevVersion(package_version) (lib/core/versions.js:243), never by this code. install_unmanaged: the remedy is the install.sh one-liner, not `claude-web-chat update`. link_mismatch: PATH resolves to another tree.

detail.description: A short English sentence for logs. Never parsed.

restriction.description: What the hub withholds from a degraded machine or chat. no_new_chats: the hub places no new chat on the machine. no_queue_delivery: messages for its chats stay held in the hub's queue, as for an offline machine (contract 07). read_only_relay: the chat's surface is relayed at the read level for every user whatever their grant (contract 04).

message.description: What the person reads, on the hub's Machines settings and in the connector's terminal output: the same text in both places.

text.description: One or two sentences naming both versions and the window.

command.description: The command to run on the machine, chosen by install.kind: 'claude-web-chat update' (managed), a git pull in the checkout (dev), or the install.sh one-liner (unmanaged). For a behind verdict whose only reasons are claude_code_below_min or claude_code_missing, 'claude update' (below the floor) or null (missing), never a web-chat command; the text then names the Claude Code version and claude_code_min (C-12.15). Null when nothing needs doing.

compat.description: Hub to connector: the verdict on a hello, and again whenever a daemon_versions record changes a chat's verdict. The hub never follows a verdict with an instruction to restart, update or stop the connector (C-12.13).

state.description: ok: inside the window. ahead: package newer than window.max, full service with a warning. behind: package older than window.min, or no Claude Code, or Claude Code below claude_code_min; degraded by restrictions. A connector on a dev build is ok; refused by the protocol row; behind by a Claude Code row: the package rows are skipped, the protocol and Claude Code rows apply (C-12.11, C-12.13). refused: the protocol ranges do not meet; the hub closes the connection after sending this.

protocol.description: The connector protocol version the hub chose (the highest both speak), or null when refused.

window.description: The web-chat versions this hub supports, inclusive at both ends, compared with compareVersions.

min.description: Oldest web-chat the hub serves in full.

max.description: Newest web-chat the hub was tested against.

protocol.description: The connector protocol range the hub speaks.

claude_code_min.description: The Claude Code floor for queue delivery (C-12.10): MOD_MIN_CLAUDE, 2.1.287 (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/mod-protocol.js:105), by the user's ruling. A machine below it keeps its chats but gets no_queue_delivery (C-12.13). Null only for a hub that sets no floor.

hub.description: The hub's own versions, for display on the machine.

web_chat.description: The web-chat version the hub depends on (its pinned dependency).

reasons.description: Why the state is what it is. Empty when state is ok and nothing else is worth saying.

restrictions.description: Machine-wide restrictions in force. Empty unless state is behind.

daemons.description: Per-chat verdicts for daemons whose own package_version is outside the window. A chat not listed is ok; a daemon on a dev build is never listed (C-12.11). Optional.

state.description: That daemon's verdict, with the meanings of compat.state (never refused: a daemon cannot fail the protocol, only the connector can).
